commitImages: relative image reads use the displayed commit, not changed working bytes
imageAccess: unauthenticated, unopened, traversal and symlink requests rejected; sibling image loads
contentsNavigation: last heading stays inside preview; both columns still fill the window
previewShortcut: Cmd+Shift+V and Ctrl+Shift+V toggle the preview from the editor
rendering: GFM tables, tasks, soft breaks, syntax colors, KaTeX, local image, headings
diagramEditing: diagram labels update from unsaved text and recover on undo
liveEditing: unsaved draft and Vim undo update preview without a disk write
invalidInput: invalid math and diagrams remain readable; HTML and unsafe URLs stay inert
